description: This file contains the implementation for interfacing with the MCP3208 external ADC chip, including SPI communication, request handling, callback functions, and utility functions for reading ADC values.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the 12-bit ADC value from the stored results for a specific channel.

methods.name: getMcp3208adc
methods.description: Returns the ADC value for a specific channel via the global state.

methods.name: getNextChannel
methods.description: Determines the next ADC channel to read from, cycling between channels.

methods.name: spiCallback
methods.description: SPI callback function invoked upon completion of an SPI exchange, processes received data and updates results.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Prepares the transmission buffer to request a specific channel's ADC reading.

methods.name: requestAdcValue
methods.description: Initiates an SPI exchange to request an ADC value for a given channel.

methods.name: requestAdcValueI
methods.description: Initiates a non-blocking SPI exchange to request an ADC value for a given channel.

methods.name: adc_in_out
methods.description: Prints ADC status, including error ratios and channel readings.

methods.name: init_adc_mcp3208
methods.description: Initializes the MCP3208 ADC interface with provided SPI driver.
